entry.title: How to Back Up Self-Hosted Spliit: PostgreSQL Dumps, S3 Receipts and a Docker Restore That Loses Nothing
entry.summary: A complete Spliit backup is three things, not one: a compressed pg_dump of the PostgreSQL database, a copy of the S3 or MinIO bucket holding receipt images, and the .env file that defines your base URL and storage credentials. Capture all three on the same schedule, keep one copy off the machine that runs the containers, and restore them in that order onto a Spliit image of the same minor version.
